title: Irresponsible Mom Leaves Her Toddler With Strangers After Getting Wasted
description:
On January 22nd, 2025. Police responded to a situation involving a woman who got drunk, abandoned her car on the road then proceeds to hitch hike with her toddler on the highway then leaves him with strangers when police were coming.
